reading: A renovation in seven phases, one after another, with the residents at home throughout and the inspection running alongside the work, not after it.

phases.company: one measure for both countries, with its cost
phases.note: Telekom's 2030 targets have no measure that compares with T-Mobile's; the measure is the article's proposal (section 9, point 1)

phases.company: ways to prove who is calling, [[14]] → [[3]]; customer data made usable
one switch between models; sensitive data hosted in Germany
phases.note: the model-switch layer and sovereign hosting are on Telekom's slide (R6-05); its AI factory in Munich (R6-24)

phases.company: [[1]] read, [[2]] actions that can be undone, [[3]] risky changes last
phases.note: the article's own proposal (section 9, point 4); changing bank details after login already exists (R6-16)
phases.phrase: keys handed out one by one

phases.company: the staff who stay learn the new tools
phases.note: missing knowledge is the reason German firms name most often for not using AI (R7-06)
the return has to come from fewer repeat contacts, other work, and the agreed exit routes (R12-01); the article's proposal (section 9, point 3)

phases.company: works agreement and AI Act settled while building

residents.company: staff: no dismissals for business reasons until end of 2028

headline: Renovate in this order, with the residents at home, and inspect while you build.
